CustomField.description: The certificate this order's exemption rests on. Set only where tax was not charged on a taxable destination, and the record it points at is the evidence for that. Restricted on delete: a certificate that an order relies on cannot be removed out from under it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The certificate this order's exemption rests on. Blank on any taxed order.
CustomField.label: Tax Exemption Certificate
